book.name: 2 Korintofɔ
book.title: Ɔwʋlʋ́ Nyɔɔsɩá Paulo Lɔ́wanlɩ́n Sɩ́sɩ́ Korintofɔ

content: Otse saasɩ nɛbá mlɩ wá á. Bulu asʋ́n lɛblɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Asa mlɛ́ha ɔkʋ ɩpɔ́n á, mlɩnu adansɩfɔ abanyɔ́ ntɛ́ɛ abasá ɔnɔ́.”
Brɛ́á nɛba mlɩ wá otse nyɔɔsɩ a, nɛda ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋdɛ lakpan bwɛ ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ ɔlá. Ntráa ndɛ amʋ́a aha tráhɛ fɛ́ɛ́ ɔlá da, tsúfɛ́ nɩ́ nɛbá ɩnʋ á, nɛ́hɩɛ bɩ́tɩ́ amʋ́ ɩsʋ.
Tsúfɛ́ mlɩdékléá mlɛ́bɩ ánɩ́ lɛ́lɛ́ Kristo dɛ́tɔɩ́ tsʋn mɩsʋ. Kristo ɔwʋnlɩ́n ɔnɔ́ mɔkʋ́ba asɩ mlɩtɔ. Mʋ túmi ɛ́ ɩhɩ́ɛ́ tsɔ mlɩtɔ.

Ɩbʋ mʋ́tɔ́á mʋ oyikpalíhɛsʋ lowu ilosuná ánɩ́ alapɔn, támɛ séi á, otsie nkpa Bulu túmitɔ. Brɛ́á anɩa mʋnyɔ anɩlɔ́bwɛ kʋlɛ a, anɩlɔ́pɔn, támɛ séi anɩa mʋnyɔ anɩtsie nkpa Bulu túmitɔ. Mʋ́ anɩdɛ́pʋkpá mlɩ nɩ́.

Mlɩyɔ mlɩ nwuntɔ kɩ bɛɛ, ahógyipʋ onutó mlɩgyí? Mlɩkapʋ mlɩ ɩwɩ kɩ bɛɛ, lɛ́lɛ́ Kristo Yesu bʋ mlɩtɔ? Mlɩlawun ánɩ́ ɔbʋ mlɩtɔ? Nɩ́ mlɩmɔ́kʋ́wun mʋ mlɩtɔ mʋ́ á, mʋ́mʋ́ megyí ahógyipʋ onutó mlɩgyí.
Nahogyiá mlɛ́ba bɛbɩ ánɩ́ Kristo ahógyipʋ onutó anɩgyí.

Anɩdɛ́ Bulu kokóli anɩaa, mlɩmátrá bwɛ lalahɛ kʋkʋ. Megyí alɩá ibósuná ánɩ́ anɩgyí Kristo ahógyipʋ onutó sʋ. Támɛ nɩ́ ahá bʋdɛkɩ́ɩ bɛɛ megyí Kristo ahógyipʋ onutó anɩgyí ó á, ɔhá mlɩ mʋ́ amlɩbwɛ tɔ́á ɩda ɔkpa.
Tsúfɛ́ anɩ mʋ́ anɩmɛ́ɛtalɩ́ kʋ́sʋ́ lɩ́ɩ́ ɔnɔkwalɩ asʋ́n ámʋsʋ, dʋn ánɩ́ abɛ́ha mʋ́ ɩbɔ́yɔ nkpá wʋlɛ.
Nɩ́ anɩ mʋ́ anɩ ɔwʋnlɩ́n ɔnɔ́ laba asɩ, mlɩ klɛ́ ɩlawá ɔnlɩn á, ansɩ́ bégyi anɩ. Tɔ́á anɩdɛ́ Bulu kʋlɩ́ gyí, ɔhá amlɩlalɩɩ kínkíínkín, amlɩdan Kristo hógyitɔ.

Ɩ́nɩ sʋ́ nagyankpá ndɛ ɔwʋlʋ́ ánfɩ wanlɩ́n sɩ́sɩ́ mlɩ, asa amba ɩnʋ nɩ́. Mɛ́nɩ nɩ́ nɛbá á, mmóobotsu ɩbɩ mlɩsʋ. Tsúfɛ́ ndekléá nɔ́pʋ túmi ámʋ́ʋ́ anɩ Wíe lapʋ́há mɩ́ ámʋ bʋ́a mlɩ amlɩdan. Mmɔ́ɔpʋyíntá mlɩ.

Apíó, ɩtráhɛ a, ansɩ́ igyí mlɩ. Mlɩbɔ mbɔ́dɩ́ amlɩlɩɩ kínkíínkín, amlɩdan Kristo hógyitɔ. Mlɩwa aba ɔwʋnlɩ́n. Mlɩ agywɩɩn ɩbwɛ́ kʋlɛ, amlɩtsia iwilwiitɔ, mɛ́nɩ Bulu ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔtɔdwɛ́ anɩ, ɔtɛhá anɩ iwilwii amʋ obétsiá mlɩtɔ brɛ́ fɛ́ɛ́. Nɛhá mlɩ itsiá gyágyáágyá.
Mlɩha aba itsiá, amlɩlata aba puta ɔdwɛsʋ. Bulu ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋbʋ nfɩ ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bɛhá mlɩ itsiá gyágyáágyá.
Anɩ Wíe Yesu Kristo bʋalɛgyí, Bulu ɔdwɛ pʋ́ Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ kʋlɛbwɛ itsía mlɩ fɛ́ɛ́sʋ́.
